description:
During a recent match in Kaiserslautern, Germany, soccer fans shocked the world by forming a massive pentagram in the stadium stands using colored cards. As the chilling display unfolded, a giant image of the devil rose from the center of the pentagram. Surrounding the scene were Latin words that translated to: “Hear us, Lucifer, rise from the abyss and accept our souls.”
Was this just fan “art” gone too far—or a real satanic ritual broadcast to the world?
